thread:
Nina (Partnerships): Proposal: run a 2-week "Mentor Shadow" onramp where each SI gets paired with an internal engineer for hands-on onboarding + a micro-cert at the end. Goal: shorten time-to-first-deploy and increase pass rates. Thoughts?
Owen (SI Enablement): Interesting. Pairing could help with tribal knowledge transfer. Recommend clear goals per week: week1 = infra + marketplace deploy, week2 = private/VPC + observability & hw smoke.
Farah (DevEx): I can build a shadow syllabus + starter repo. Keep exercises reproducible: CLI-first tasks and an evidence bundle uploader. Will also create a short checklist mentors follow.
Gabe (Marketplace): Marketplace will support a "mentor demo tenant" so mentors can preview listings and help debug manifest issues. Also can provide a manifest validator API.
Arjun (HW Partnerships): For HW-enabled integrators, we can offer remote kit access or loaner kits for the shadow. Need signed terms and a shipping window.
Nina (Partnerships): Thinking cohort of 4 SIs per month, mentors 1:1 for first 3 days then ad-hoc. Micro-cert = pass 3 quick stations or 2+w remediation. Issue digital badge and a co-marketing readiness review.
Owen (SI Enablement): Agree. Metrics to watch: time-to-first-successful-deploy, pass rate, and follow-up support tickets in 30 days. Also propose a short mentor retro after each cohort.
Farah (DevEx): Action items: I'll draft syllabus + starter repo (due in 5 days). Owen -> mentor playbook + rubric (due in 7 days). Gabe -> mentor tenant + validator access (due in 6 days). Arjun -> loaner kit policy + waiver template (due in 7 days). SchedulerBot: recurring draft calendar created for 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-15.
Nina (Partnerships): Nice. We'll pilot with 2 SIs this quarter. If legal or infra have concerns, flag them now. Otherwise I'll start outreach tomorrow. :rocket:
